title: Leo/need Chapter1 Episode8 Teach Me, Luka!

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It worked!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But is it okay for us to come here whenever we want?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Why not? Miku told us we could!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Besides, we wouldn't have decided to start a band if it wasn't for Miku. We should thank her!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
...
You've always been the first one to take the plunge.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Well, that's one of your good points.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Ichika and Saki.
You came to visit again.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Miku!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Miku! Thanks for everything!
Yesterday was a ton of fun!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We came here without asking... Is that okay?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You don't need to ask permission.
What happened to Shiho and Honami?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: They didn't come this time, but I'm sure we'll all end up here at some point!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That'll be something to look forward to.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We dropped by today to tell you something!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh? I'm all ears.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichika and I started a band!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Really? Hehe.
I had a feeling you might.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You played really well together.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Teehee! Thanks! We have a long way to go, though. I can play the piano, but I'm not experienced with synth.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me too, I can play some chords and simple tunes, but that's about it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We'll have to practice a lot!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see. In that case, would you like to practice here as a group? The four of us?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Did you say four?
That's right.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hello.
bgm_area00001

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Luka?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So Miku isn't the only VIRTUAL SINGER in this world?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Luka often visits to sing and play with me.
She's my bandmate, in a way.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She can play both guitar and synth, so you can learn a lot from her.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Luka will be our mentor? Wow!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Are you prepared for some intense training?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Gulp! Even if it's really hardcore, we'll try our best!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe, just kidding.
Let's have fun playing together.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I thought there would be more of you. Miku told me you had two more friends you were playing with.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
.....
Well... They're not coming this time...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Ah, I'm guessing the situation is a bit complicated.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We've been friends with the other two girls since we were little.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We used to be really close, hanging out together every day.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But then I had to stay in the hospital for a long time, and when I came back, Shiho and Hona didn't want to speak with me.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That's very sad. I wonder why?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I wish I knew, but they won't tell me anything.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Some things might be hard to say to someone you care about.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That... That's true...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Both of you still want to be friends with Honami and Shiho, right? If you're determined, I'm sure things will work out.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. If your wish is sincere, it will bring you together again some day.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Hearing you say that makes me believe it will happen!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You have to keep believing.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: All right, let's practice lots, so that we can play well when Shiho and Honami join us!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, okay. Let's do this.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Argh, I can't do it! This is so hard! Luka, I'm so sorry.
I'm no good at this.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's understandable, piano and synthesizer are different instruments after all. Take your time and you'll learn it.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Don't try to do too much too soon.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho is so good at playing. I have to up my game to match her!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Keep practicing and you'll get there.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Saki is really enjoying this.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But I bet she would be having even more fun if Honami and Shiho were with us too.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (No, I mustn't be so negative.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I have to focus on learning to play well, too, to prepare for when Shiho and Honami join our band.)
